summary: our project is an animated video of the story of opportunity, certain creative liberties has been taken in this story which potrays opportunity as it traverse the martian plane. starting out with sojourner:the first martian rover, then spirit and opportunity, spirit being broken down, opportunities  lonely journey and ending with Perseverance and the final photograph. this animation is a tiny glimpse into opportunities story as longest lasting rover on mars.
details:
Created and edited in Blender, this 1 minute 29 seconds animated video features Opportunity's journey as it traversed the Martian plane

The story encapsulates the Martian rover Opportunity as well as its twin Spirit , from being unveiled to their final goodbye-hooking our attention from Sojourner , to the twins and finally Perseverance
